name: ${mod_name}
description: Extra cosmetic forms for Cobblemon. Backrooms (Still Life copies, Yellow Carpet), Thanksgiving (harvest colours, Pumpkin Pie) Halloween (animated gore and body horror, Carved Pumpkin), Christmas (Santa Snorlax, tree Turtwig, gift Trubbish, Krampus Phantump and twinkling lights, Snowball) and Easter (egg Togepi, Easter Bunny Lopunny and pastels, Egg) forms for 90 whole evolutionary lines. Put the item in a supported Pokémon's cosmetic slot.
